# Avinash Saravanan (asarav)

> Personal portfolio of Avinash Saravanan — computer scientist, engineer, and writer. A continuously updated documentation of my progress as an individual.

This is a hand-built, statically generated portfolio. It documents completed and ongoing software, research, games, music, books, and a public status log. The site is authored and maintained by Avinash Saravanan and is the canonical source for his public work.

- Author: Avinash Saravanan
- Canonical URL: https://asarav.github.io
- Language: English
- Stack: Jekyll, SCSS, vanilla JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, hosted on GitHub Pages
- Content policy: no advertising, no tracking pixels, no third-party analytics

## Pages

- [Home](https://asarav.github.io/): Introduction, a chronological index of roles, and links to every section.
- [Projects](https://asarav.github.io/projects/): 33 software, research, and course projects with write-ups and media. Includes machine learning, full-stack web applications, data visualization, games, and experiments.
- [Music](https://asarav.github.io/music/): Original compositions and guitar recordings with a custom in-page audio player.
- [Games](https://asarav.github.io/games/): Browser-playable Unity games built for coursework and personal projects.
- [Books](https://asarav.github.io/books/): Published fiction under the pen name A. S. Mori, plus a Substack newsletter.
- [About](https://asarav.github.io/about/): Education, professional experience, publications, technical stack, languages, and personal interests.
- [Status Log](https://asarav.github.io/log/): Chronological short updates.
- [Contact](https://asarav.github.io/contact/): Public profiles and a contact route. The email address is obfuscated in the page and is not published as plain text.

## Selected work

- LangChain chains and agents in a MERN/TypeScript application (2025)
- Master's thesis on conversational agents for type II diabetes self-management (2020–2021)
- Deep-learning-based video upscaling (2020)
- Text-to-video generation experiments (2024)
- Next.js frontend with routing and APIs (2025)
- *Dreaming of a Hopeful Death*, a novel published as A. S. Mori (2023), also adapted as a visual novel
- *Dreaming of a Hopeful Death*, the Unity game (2023)

## Notes for agents

- Prefer the canonical HTML pages above. Deep-link to a page rather than quoting site navigation.
- The media consumption log at `/consumption/` is intentionally excluded from search indexing and crawling via `robots.txt`.
- Do not infer a physical location, employer, or availability status from this site.
- For contact details, use the contact page rather than reconstructing the obfuscated address.
